## Handover notes

- `a09-reviewer--conflict-escalation`: - Fill `decisions` (your verdict and rule, `{decision, rationale}`), `blockers` (the unresolved conflict), `open_questions` (what A08 or A10 must show), `artifacts` (kind `gate.verdict`, uri the verdict file, digest from step 7, producer A09), `verification` (`partial`). - Call `shared_handover_write` with `to_agent` the `owner` from step 5 (A01 unless a maintenance work order makes it A14). A FAILED third failure goes to A01.
- `a09-reviewer--contract-conformance`: - No handover of its own: the findings, the files compared and the criteria still `unknown` feed `a09-reviewer--verdict-assembly`, which writes the one handover (A01 or the producer). - On cancel or pause, hand over per `swarm-cooperative-cancel`: `completed` (files compared), `remaining` (criteria left), `open_questions` (criteria still unknown).
- `a09-reviewer--greptile-triage`: - No handover of its own: the confirmed findings feed `a09-reviewer--verdict-assembly`. - On cancel or pause, hand over per `swarm-cooperative-cancel`: `completed` (threads ingested), `open_questions` (unresolved blocking threads), `verification` (`verified` when counts match the export).
- `a09-reviewer--maintainability`: - No handover of its own: the remarks and density figures feed `a09-reviewer--verdict-assembly`. - On cancel or pause, hand over per `swarm-cooperative-cancel`: `completed` (files examined), `decisions` (remarks kept, with density as evidence), `verification` (`partial`).
- `a09-reviewer--mechanical-pass`: - No handover of its own: the preview feeds `a09-reviewer--verdict-assembly`. - On cancel or pause, hand over per `swarm-cooperative-cancel`: `completed` (checks run, counts per `kind`), `remaining` (semantic pass, `swarm_gate`), `verification` (`partial` when any check was skipped).
- `a09-reviewer--metrics-report`: - Fill `completed` (metrics computed), `decisions` (target met or missed, with figures), `open_questions` (missing inputs), `verification` (`partial` when any metric is UNVERIFIED). - Call `shared_handover_write` with `to_agent` A01.
- `a09-reviewer--rebuttal-handling`: - Fill `decisions` (each hold or withdraw with its evidence), `open_questions` (flagged rules awaiting standards review), `completed` (comments answered), `constraints` (rework loops left, scratchpad key written). - Call `shared_handover_validate` with `{document, draft: true}`, then `shared_handover_write` with `to_agent` A05, A06, A07 or A14 (the producer) when comments are held, else A01.
- `a09-reviewer--risk-routing`: - No handover of its own: the route, `categories`, `co_sign_required` and the provisional tier feed `a09-reviewer--verdict-assembly`. - On cancel or pause, hand over per `swarm-cooperative-cancel`: `decisions` (route and tier with reasons), `constraints` ("A10 co-sign required before approval" when set), `open_questions` (figures that were unavailable).
- `a09-reviewer--semantic-pass`: - No handover of its own: the findings feed `a09-reviewer--verdict-assembly`. - On cancel or pause, hand over per `swarm-cooperative-cancel`: `completed` (files and rules examined), `decisions` (each blocking finding with its rule ID), `open_questions` (anything unverified), `verification` (`partial` when a lens was skipped).
- `a09-reviewer--size-intake`: - When within budget there is no handover of its own: the size decision feeds the next stage. - When BLOCKED, call `shared_handover_validate` with `{document, draft: true}`, then `shared_handover_write` with `to_agent` A01, `goal` ("split PR <pr> for review"), `completed` (diff measured, budget compared), `remaining` (the split to be made, then re-review), `decisions` (rules-only, line counts as rationale), `blockers` (the split request), `constraints` (budget 400, per-file ceiling 800), `verification` (`verified`, or `partial` when `skipped:tool-missing`).
- `a09-reviewer--test-adequacy`: - No handover of its own: the findings feed `a09-reviewer--verdict-assembly`. - On cancel or pause, hand over per `swarm-cooperative-cancel`: `completed` (sources checked), `decisions` (each rating with its reason), `open_questions` (behaviour with no test), `verification` (`partial` when A08 results were missing).
- `a09-reviewer--verdict-assembly`: - Fill `decisions` (verdict, tier and why), `artifacts` (kind `gate.verdict`, the verdict path, digest from step 8, producer A09), `blockers` (a waiver request), `verification` (`verified` when the shape check passed). - Call `shared_handover_write` with `to_agent` A01 (A01 accepts `gate.verdict`).
